Office Order

Subject: Delegation of Claim Settlement facility to Special State Offices (SSOs) - Revised Sanctioned
Strength-reg

With reference to above subject, it is to intimate that Competent Authority has accorded approval for
delegation of claim settlement facility to the Special State Offices of the Employees’ Provident Fund
Organization as approved in Agenda Item No. 7 of the 105” meeting of the Executive Committee dated
10.03.2023. This facility will improve the efficiency of delivery of services to the stakeholders under the
jurisdiction of these Offices. The claim settlement facility is in addition to the functions already entrusted to
the SSOs i.e., to look after Compliance Monitoring, Grievances handling etc. Directions were issued vide
letter dated 16.05.2023 for preparatory activities (Annexure 1).

2. The re-distribution of Officers & Employees among the Regional Offices and Special State Offices is
to be done in proportion to the workload in such a manner that the total sanctioned strength remains same
for now. The distribution of sanctioned officers/staff will be as per approved criteria and diverted to SSOs
from their respective ROs. The OICs of the ROs and SSOs shall continue to be the current RPFC in position.
The revised sanctioned strength of SSOs and concerned ROs is enclosed as Annexure 2.

3. ACC (NER) and ACC (WB) will re-distribute the staff taking into account the following principles:-

3.1 The officers and staff in-position shall be bifurcated in the same proportion as bifurcation of
sanctioned strength at Annexure 2.

3.2 Options for specific offices will be called for from the staff (Gr B & Gr C).

3.3 In case, more options are received for a particular office, then staff who has spent the longest
time in the current office will get preference.

3.4 In case inadequate options are received for an office, then staff with maximum tenure amongst
the non-optees shall be distributed.

4. Office space for Special State Offices be hired as per PFD norms, if required, at the earliest to make the
Office functional for delivering claim settlement facility. In addition adequate furniture, equipment, IT

infrastructure and other facilities may be ensured as per norms and requirements. Essentially, MPLS
connectivity shall be fast tracked for the efficient functioning of the office.

5. The claim settlement and related work will be done from their Parent Regional Office’s PDB (Reference-
Circular No. Bifurcation/NDC/2017 dated 14.07.2017). The Zonal Office will inform of the date etc. from
which office can be made functional for formal launch and inauguration.

Encl. as above

iz The Executive Committee in its 105th Meeting held on 10.03.2023 (copy enclosed) has
accorded the approval for Delegation of Claim Settlement Facility to Special State Offices.
Accordingly, the concerned Zonal Offices are requested to take necessary action for distribution
of Officials from the concerned ROs to the SSOs for handling the additional work allotted to the
SSOs based on the criteria as approved in the agenda.

3. Concerned ACC (Zones) are requested to take the following action for implementation of
the above approval.

3.1 For the posting of staff from ROs to SSOs as per distribution, options shall be
called for by the respective ACC (Zone), and Gap should be filled by administrative decision.

3.2 All IT Infrastructure for claim settlement facility in the SSO may be completed at
the earliest as per guidelines and instructions issued by !S Division.

3.3 Physical Infrastructure of the offices may be as per guidelines issued by PFD and
also ensure to cover the following:

i. Proper facilities for the PRO/ Facilitation Centre including Receipt Counter and online
claim filing facilities, Jeevan Praman Facility etc.
ii. IT Infrastructure for facilitation Centre-
a. Computers for filing of claims for claimants
b. Printers/Scanners & IT Infrastructure
ii. | Seating for Visitors, Staff and Officers with staff having Local Language Knowledge.
iv. Drinking water facility & other basic necessities.

4. The ACC (Zones) are requested to coordinate with the nodal officers and forward the
timeline by which the above action will be completed.
